phrases.latin: parietēs omnēs, utī jussitur, calce et caementīs; pīlās ex lapide angulārī; tigna omnia quae opus sunt; līmina, postēs, jugūmenta, asserēs
phrases.english: all the walls, as ordered, of lime and rubble; the pillars of squared stone; all the timbers needed; thresholds, doorposts, lintels, rafters
